answer.summary: The API Types Check failed because the types generated from the running API differ from the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts. The log shows new fields (has_more, consistency_mode, last_verified_at, and others) that the committed file lacks, which points to this PR changing API DTOs without regenerating the types. The mismatch is deterministic, so a rerun on the same commit will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
